title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 121 (Report on annual general meeting)

content.overview: Every listed public company shall prepare in the prescribed manner a report on each annual general meeting including confirmation that the meeting was convened, held and conducted as per the Act and rules, and shall file a copy with the Registrar within thirty days of the conclusion of the AGM.
content.glance: A listed public company must prepare the prescribed AGM report and file it with the Registrar within thirty days of conclusion of the AGM.
content.study:
## Section 121 — Report on annual general meeting

**Who must file.** Every listed public company must prepare a report on each AGM in the prescribed manner and file it with the Registrar within thirty days of conclusion of the AGM.

**Contents and form.** Use the prescribed form and current Companies (Management and Administration) Rules. The report is distinct from the minutes required by section 118 and from the inspection rights in section 119.

**Checklist.** Confirm listed-public-company status; record the AGM conclusion date; prepare the report in the current prescribed form; file within thirty days; retain the acknowledgement; check the current penalty for default.

This note is a focused study aid; the topic remains under source and current-law review.

hypotheticals.question: Does keeping minutes under section 118 replace the section 121 report?
